entry_points.text: Dispatch honors may-deactivate for active versus inactive; inactive reclaims one LRU via throttle isolate reclaim putback; active scans one LRU via drain isolate triage requeue.
Consume isolated collection with scan context, separate freed and survivors, add demoted to reclaimed, drain batched frees with discharge flush, submit swap output, splice survivors and return total.
Free contiguous slots after last reference; end handle lifetime with page reclamation check; decrement zone residency during teardown.

exports.text: Record signed node deltas, per-cpu memcg events and shadow aging, propagating to ancestors with traces.
Return isolated folios, free batches by zone, wait on per-node queues with per-reason timeouts, estimate reclaimable.
Check swap headroom, filter nodes, report demotion targets and swap-full using global counters, memcg limits and tier masks.
Clear reclaim on dirty to protect readahead, handle mapping-less folios, and wait with tracing until writeback clears.
Allocate swap slots, remove cache entries, submit output and invalidate compressed store, handling clusters and refcounts.
Release cluster ranges, free compressed objects, decrement zone state and uncharge zswap, recycling storage and tallies.

hazards.text: Pin before clearing membership and set membership before last-ref test; curb progress loss and stall by excluding skips bounding diversions head splicing and hopeless bypass; prefer extra waits, redirty clears reclaim.

Defer page-backed table release across grace, free cache-backed immediately; queue vacant discard clusters async with anti-duplicate flags; kick background reclaim on trylock failure; ignore invalid handles and empty stores.
Select per-reason delays with writeback baseline and unknown warning; share one tick for congested and no-progress after bypass; always release cache locks, free isolate types directly.
Batch same-identity container uncharges flushing on change; need locked cached non-writeback folio with matching cluster, freeing fully unused ranges together and singly in partial ranges.

invariants.text: Walk LRU head within budget, count all as scanned but only eligible as progress, divert bounded high-zone folios to head staging, skip non-LRU or pinned, subtract per-zone taken.
Reclaimer selects counter offsets with kswapd zero; anon needs swap headroom else demotion with flag tier mask and filtered nodes; skip no-progress wait when hopeless or writeback small.
Skip refs when ignored else reactivate retain or continue; adjust scanned on large-to-small split; divert demote candidates with one migration, rejoin failures, retry non-proactive without demotion.

Anon swap needs IO allowance, no pinning, large exclusivity, split retry; unmap uses batched flush and pin guard; file dirty reactivates, other dirty needs safe entry; single-ref mapping-less frees via batch, lazy-free freezes, activation sets state.
Distinguish cleared and countable encodings; count valid only for countable; removal needs locked cached non-writeback folio with matching cluster, zeroing values and freeing unused ranges.
Index derives from displacement; occupancy drop selects free discard or partial; cleanup orders before availability restore; avail uses off-list marker with fullness checks.
Shard compressed store by type and shifted offset; teardown drops tree pool container and accounting; uncharge skips non-default hierarchy and root, else reduces tallies.

Fullness bands derive from inuse with vacant and saturated endpoints; identity needs magic with huge as singleton; release updates inuse and freelist; lockless teardown needs vacant inuse and held locks.
Accumulate per-cpu deltas locally, fold excess into zone totals past thresholds with hysteresis; forward page decrements to zone handling.
Reclaim and swap-table paths rely on external list folio debug lock atomic and barrier helpers defined elsewhere.

locks.text: Drain then hold lruvec IRQ lock across isolation, which walks moves entries and updates sizes, recording isolate and scan counts.
Hold at most one lruvec IRQ lock, switching vectors, set membership before last-ref test, unlock around putback free and uncharge.
Use per-zone per-cpu trylocks, dropping on zone change or isolate types with direct-free fallback; hold RCU for tier lookup.
Derive cluster by offset quotient with swapoff and bound checks, need task context and live users, take spin guard with optional IRQ mask, null without swap.
Hold folio guard for swap-full test allocation and cache removal; read guards span ancestors and vectors; drop folio guard before writeback wait and requeue outside IRQ.
Need cluster lock with RCU for table and container; nest device inside cluster for move; use global lock for avail; mutate class stats and fullness under class lock; unwind partial page-set trylocks.

state_machines.text: Stage into hold active inactive; per folio yield detach return non-evictable release buffers under pressure rotate referenced executable to active else clear active for deactivation, then requeue account and trace.
Wait while too many isolated, abort on stall or fatal signal, drain isolate under lock with reclaimer counters, reclaim via folio-list path, requeue survivors, record demote steal rotate and trace.

Drain staging, lock correct lruvec, assert membership clear, detach, putback non-evictable, else mark membership, batch last-ref frees with uncharge, else re-add survivors aging nonresident for still-active.
Prepare drops failures and directly frees non-cacheable orders while compacting; commit resolves zone and migrate type, switches locks on zone change, normalizes high types to movable with fallback.

Init free return demote staging, cache demotion, loop detaching try-locking handling poison classifying dirty writeback congested, triage writeback via reactivate or wait, page out unmap free in batches with discharge flush migrate demotes splice survivors.

Clusters move unlinked free and discard-pending by occupancy; slots move among encodings with clearing on release; fullness migrates on occupancy with vacancy reclaim; compressed goes present erase release.

structs.text: Lruvec has per-LRU lists and nonresident age; scan control has reclaim index order unmap and deactivate rights memcg and priority; node has isolate counts wait queues and writeback throttle.
Folio batch has count array and reinit; zone has per-cpu sets write-pending and file anon snapshots; memcg has per-cpu events and swap maximum.
Cluster has lock occupancy flag order hint linkage and table pointer; table is RCU pointer to atomic slots by intra-cluster offset.
Class has lock per-fullness chains and stats; backing set has inuse fullness linkage huge and magic; descriptor aliases folio and page forwarding lock ref and mapping.
Counters include node isolate and lruvec scan steal demote rotate by file type and reclaimer with kswapd base; throttle timeouts derive from HZ; cleared-word and fixed count subfields.
